newsitem.title: USA: CNA Financial to invest in crop software.
newsitem.headline: CNA Financial to invest in crop software.

text.p: CNA Financial Corp said its CNA Agriculture unit is forming a new company that will develop, acquire and invest in high-tech applications for crop and farm insurance agents working with CNA.

The company said its new CNA Agriculture Technology & Services Inc division will deliver software applications geared toward crop agents for policy management, quote preparation and customer risk management.
CNA Agriculture is one of the nation's largest writers of crop and farm insurance policies.
CNA Financial is an insurance holding company whose shares were trading up 1/4 Tuesday at 106-1/4.
